{{Top|leg}}
A '''voting sponsor''' was one of the corporations that invested in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Voting sponsors had to contribute an initial investment of over fifty quadrillion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and provide equipment, vehicles, and technical systems for the Authority. Half of the investment was as a direct gift of credits or facilities, and half was a combination of stock and bonds. Voting sponsors were entitled to have a member of the company serve as a [[Direx]] on the [[Executive Directorship Board]]. Voting sponsors could also buy raw materials and bulk goods at a discount.
